name: s7-first-grid
note: The first S7 grid (2026-10-22): six knobs the lanes changed one sibling at a time, over the S7 default, subsampled (seeded: the same 220 of the 324 combinations whatever n up to 220, since a larger n keeps the same permutation's prefix); the evidence ranking is crossed with every kept config, because its twin shares the sequencing's cells and costs only the final ranking. The per-bend gate is one option over two steps' knobs (the sequencing's chain and follower gate, the placement's gate), as the recorded gate was one constant.
